title: Delete the Top friends reader, writers, Spotlight block and settings panel
detail: Owner ask: take Top friends out (part 2 of 2, after SCAN-1181). The reader and writers, the Spotlight and Puck block types, the profile widget and the Top friends section of the appearance panel are deleted. A stored Top friends block drops the next time a layout is saved. The spotlight_top_friends table is left in the database untouched.

verify.evidence: The Top friends code is gone.
